name: Headhunter
text: Once per game: swap a rival’s member with a shop member of equal or greater cost.

name: Host
text: On Recruit: +1 red per 2 members. Round Start: +1 red per 2 members.

name: Loyalists
text: Your other members can’t be swapped.

name: Mentor & Protégé
text: On Recruit: recruit the cheapest member in the shop.

name: Mob
text: Game end: +1 follower per red member.

name: Movement Penalty
text: When you move a rival’s member out of their cult, they lose 1 follower.

name: Panel
text: On Recruit: Promote or Demote another member.

name: Patriarch
text: Game end: +1 follower per 2 members.

name: Proselytizer
text: Whenever you recruit, +1 follower.

name: Recruit Bonus
text: Whenever one of your members’ "On Recruit" happens, +1 of its color.

name: Recruiter
text: Whenever you add a member to your cult, +1 red.

name: Triplets
text: Worth 3 followers.

name: Volunteer
text: Worth 1 follower.

name: Agents
text: Your actions can’t be copied.

name: Bait
text: Whenever anyone copies your action, they −1 follower. If it’s a rival, +1 follower.

name: Chronicler
text: Game end: +1 follower per green member.

name: Tribute Band
text: Once per game: do every action a rival you choose has a minion on this round.

name: Doppelganger
text: On Recruit: it becomes a copy of one of your members.

name: Ensemble
text: Whenever you copy your own action, +1 follower.

name: Busker
text: On Recruit: +2 green. Round Start: +2 green.

name: Stunt Double
text: On Recruit: copy the action you just took.

name: Impostor
text: On Recruit: it becomes a copy of a rival’s member.
